image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a Brown Pelican standing on a rocky surface near water. The bird features a long, distinctive bill with a large gular pouch, dark brown and grey plumage on the body and wings, and a lighter, whitish-grey head and neck. The background is a blurred natural setting of water and earth tones.
